sections.markdown:
| Module | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `base64` | Base64 encoding/decoding |
| `cluster` | Distributed cluster communication |
| `compress` | Compression/decompression and checksums |
| `crypto` | Cryptographic hashing, encryption, randomness, and constant-time comparison |
| `csv` | CSV parsing and generation |
| `datetime` | Date and time manipulation |
| `encoding` | Character encoding conversion |
| `http` | HTTP/1.x client/server, REST API, and routing |
| `http2` | HTTP/2 capability and typed request transport |
| `io` | File I/O operations |
| `log` | Structured logging system |
| `math` | Mathematical functions |
| `mem` | Raw memory, Buffer, page allocation, volatile access, and memory primitives |
| `net` | TCP/UDP/TLS networking |
| `os` | Operating system interface |
| `parallel` | Structured CPU data-parallel operations |
| `path` | File path manipulation |
| `regex` | Regular expressions |
| `runtime` | Runtime and heap introspection |
| `sync` | Coroutine-domain synchronization primitives |
| `sys` | OS-thread-domain system primitives |
| `time` | Time, timers, sleep |
| `toml` | TOML configuration parsing |
| `url` | URL parsing and construction |
| `ws` | WebSocket client and server |
| `xml` | XML parsing |
| `yaml` | YAML parsing |

Usage: `import <module>` then call `module.function()`. All listed modules ship in the Xray standard-library installation unit.

Built-in JSON helpers are exposed as `Json.parse()` / `Json.encode()` / `Json.stringify()` without `import`.
